```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# the fits take a few minutes; set POPPKFLOW_SLOW=true to evaluate the code
run <- identical(Sys.getenv("POPPKFLOW_SLOW"), "true")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", eval = run)
```

Population PK model development is a loop: specify a model, fit it, diagnose it,
compare it with its parent, decide, and modify. `poppkflow` records every pass of
the loop in a ledger.

```{r project}
library(poppkflow)
proj <- pk_project(file.path(tempdir(), "vignette_project"), name = "Example")
pk_covariates(tibble::tribble(
  ~name , ~type         , ~ref,
  "WT"  , "continuous"  , 70  ,
  "CRCL", "continuous"  , 100 ,
  "SEXF", "categorical" , NA
))
dat <- pk_data(system.file("extdata", "example_pk.csv", package = "poppkflow"))
pk_check(dat)
```

## Base model

A model is described as data. `pk_code()` shows the generated `nlmixr2` code.

```{r base}
base_spec <- pk_spec(
  ncmt = 2, lag = TRUE, iiv = c("ka", "cl", "v2"),
  inits = list(ka = 1, cl = 5, v2 = 30, q = 4, v3 = 50, tlag = 0.25)
)
cat(pk_code(base_spec))
r1 <- pk_run(base_spec, est = pk_est(method = "focei"), note = "Base model", stage = "structural")
pk_diagnostics(r1)
```

## A modification suggested by the data

Every editing verb takes a run (or specification) and returns a candidate that
remembers its parent.

```{r cov}
r2 <- r1 |>
  pk_add_cov("cl", "WT", form = "power", init = 0.75) |>
  pk_add_cov("v2", "WT", form = "power", init = 1) |>
  pk_inits_from(r1) |>
  pk_run(est = pk_est(method = "focei"), note = "Weight on CL and V2", stage = "covariate")
pk_compare(r1, r2)
pk_decide(r2, "accepted", reason = "dOFV exceeds the 1% criterion for 2 df, effects plausible")
```

## History and lineage

```{r history}
pk_history()
pk_tree()
pk_audit()
```

## Covariate screening and SCM

```{r scm}
pk_screen_covariates(r1)
cands <- tibble::tribble(
  ~param, ~covariate, ~form   , ~ref, ~init,
  "cl"  , "WT"      , "power" , 70  , 0.75 ,
  "cl"  , "CRCL"    , "power" , 100 , 0.1  ,
  "cl"  , "SEXF"    , "cat"   , NA  , 0
)
scm <- pk_scm(r1, cands, est = pk_est(method = "focei"), require_cov_step = FALSE)
scm$steps
```

## Evaluation and report

```{r eval, eval = FALSE}
pk_bootstrap(scm$final, n = 200)
pk_bootstrap_summary(scm$final)
pk_vpc(scm$final, n = 500)
pk_exposure(scm$final, dose = 100, ii = 24)
pk_report(scm$final)
```
